name: Yamano Takayuki
source: Takayuki is our lovable failure of a hero. Disappointed at having to return to the inn but determined to prove his worth, Takayuki's attitude will often waffle between apathetic laziness and fleeting resolution. Working at the inn does suit him, however, because he definitely possesses a perverted streak.
